title: ADAPTIVE REINFORCEMENT LEARNING OF MULTI-AGENT ETHICALLY-ALIGNED BEHAVIOURS: THE QSOM AND QDSOM ALGORITHMS
reasoning: The paper focuses on 'Machine Ethics' and introduces reinforcement learning algorithms (QSOM and QDSOM) specifically designed to ensure 'ethically-aligned behaviours' in AI agents. It evaluates these algorithms based on their ability to adapt to changes in ethical considerations and moral values.
